encoding.description: Output character encoding: utf8, gb, or big5.

char_style.description: Chinese character style: simplified or traditional. Only applies if encoding is utf8.

convert_lunar_to_solar.description: If true, converts a Lunar date to Solar date. If false, converts Solar to Lunar.

leap_month.description: Indicates the input month is a leap month. Only meaningful when convert_lunar_to_solar is true.

bitmap_ganzhi.description: If true, outputs ganzhi (stem-branch) in bitmap characters.

year.description: The year for the date conversion.

month.description: The month for the date conversion (1-12).

day.description: The day for the date conversion.

hour.description: The hour for the date conversion (0-23). Optional.
